actions.add_comment_reaction.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a comment.
actions.add_comment_reaction.props.emoji: Emoji shortcode with colons, e.g. :heart:, :+1: or :eyes:.
actions.add_comment_reaction.props.file_: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_comment.description: Deletes a comment you posted on a Figma file.
The ID of the comment to delete (from Get File Comments).
actions.delete_comment.props.file_key.de: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.export_node_images.description: Renders layers of a Figma file as PNG, JPG, SVG or PDF and returns the image links (optionally downloads the files).
actions.export_node_images.props.downloa: Also download the images and store them as files for later steps (up to 10 images, 50 MB each).
actions.export_node_images.props.file_ke: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.export_node_images.props.ids.des: Node IDs to render, like 1:2 (up to 50).
actions.get_comments.description: Lists the comments on a Figma file, optionally only unresolved ones or ones after a date.
actions.get_comments.props.as_md.descrip: Return comment messages as Markdown instead of plain text.
actions.get_comments.props.file_key.desc: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.get_comments.props.since.descrip: Only return comments created after this date and time.
actions.get_current_user.description: Gets the Figma user of this connection.
actions.get_file.description: Gets a Figma file as JSON: pages, layers, components and styles. Set a depth or node IDs to keep the result small.
actions.get_file.props.branch_data.descr: Also return the list of branches of the file.
actions.get_file.props.depth.description: How deep to read the tree: 1 = pages only, 2 = pages and their top-level layers. Leave empty for the whole file (can be very large).
actions.get_file.props.file_key.descript: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.get_file.props.ids.description: Only return these nodes and their parents (e.g. 1:2). Leave empty for the whole file.
actions.get_file.props.version.descripti: Read an older version of the file. Leave empty for the current version.
actions.get_file_metadata.description: Gets the name, project, last edit, creator and link of a Figma file without loading its content.
actions.get_file_metadata.props.file_key: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.get_file_nodes.description: Gets the JSON of specific layers (nodes) in a Figma file.
actions.get_file_nodes.props.depth.descr: How many levels below each node to return. Leave empty for the full subtree.
actions.get_file_nodes.props.file_key.de: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.get_file_nodes.props.ids.descrip: Node IDs like 1:2 (or 1-2 as in the node-id of a Figma URL).
actions.get_file_nodes.props.version.des: Read an older version of the file. Leave empty for the current version.
actions.get_file_outline.description: Gets the pages and top-level layers of a Figma file (ID, name and type only).
actions.get_file_outline.props.depth.des: 1 = pages only, 2 = pages and their top-level layers (default), 3 = one more level.
The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.list_comment_reactions.descripti: Lists the emoji reactions on a comment.
actions.list_comment_reactions.props.com: The comment whose reactions to list.
actions.list_comment_reactions.props.cur: Leave empty for the first page. To get the next page, pass the Next Cursor from the previous run.
actions.list_comment_reactions.props.fil: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.list_file_components.description: Lists the published components of a Figma library file.
actions.list_file_components.props.file_: The Figma library file URL or file key (main file, not a branch).
actions.list_file_styles.description: Lists the published styles (colors, text, effects, grids) of a Figma library file.
The Figma library file URL or file key (main file, not a branch).
actions.list_file_versions.description: Lists the version history of a Figma file, newest first.
Leave empty for the first page. To get the next page, pass the Next Cursor from the previous run.
actions.list_file_versions.props.file_ke: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.post_comment.description: Posts a comment on a Figma file, as a reply to a comment or pinned to a layer.
actions.post_comment.props.comment_id.de: Post as a reply to this top-level comment. Leave empty for a new comment.
actions.post_comment.props.file_key.desc: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
actions.post_comment.props.node_id.descr: Attach the comment to this layer (e.g. 1:2). Not used for replies. Leave empty to post on the canvas.
actions.remove_comment_reaction.descript: Removes your emoji reaction from a comment.
actions.remove_comment_reaction.props.co: The comment to remove the reaction from.
actions.remove_comment_reaction.props.em: Emoji shortcode with colons, e.g. :heart:, :+1: or :eyes:.
actions.remove_comment_reaction.props.fi: The Figma file URL (e.g. https://www.figma.com/design/<key>/<name>) or just the file key from it. Branch URLs target the branch.
auth.description: Connect your Figma account. Connections made before version 0.7.0 must be reconnected to use versions, library, current user and trigger steps.
triggers.file_deleted.description: Triggers when a file is deleted. Needs a Figma Professional plan or higher (Starter teams are refused); team webhooks need a team admin, project and file webhooks need edit access.
triggers.file_deleted.props.context.desc: Whether to watch every file in a team, every file in a project, or one file. Team webhooks need a team admin; project and file webhooks need edit access.
triggers.file_deleted.props.context_id.d: For Team or Project, the number after /team/ or /project/ in the Figma URL (e.g. figma.com/files/team/1234567890). For File, the file URL or file key.
triggers.file_deleted.props.info.descrip: Team ID: open the team in Figma; the URL is figma.com/files/team/**1234567890**/... Project ID: open the project; the URL is figma.com/files/project/**12345678**/... File: paste the file URL.
triggers.file_updated.description: Triggers when a file is edited (Figma sends this after about 30 minutes without further edits). Needs a Figma Professional plan or higher (Starter teams are refused); team webhooks need a team admin, project and file webhooks need edit access.
triggers.file_updated.props.context.desc: Whether to watch every file in a team, every file in a project, or one file. Team webhooks need a team admin; project and file webhooks need edit access.
triggers.file_updated.props.context_id.d: For Team or Project, the number after /team/ or /project/ in the Figma URL (e.g. figma.com/files/team/1234567890). For File, the file URL or file key.
triggers.file_updated.props.info.descrip: Team ID: open the team in Figma; the URL is figma.com/files/team/**1234567890**/... Project ID: open the project; the URL is figma.com/files/project/**12345678**/... File: paste the file URL.
triggers.library_published.description: Triggers when a library file is published (components, styles or variables changed). Needs a Figma Professional plan or higher (Starter teams are refused); team webhooks need a team admin, project and file webhooks need edit access.
triggers.library_published.props.context: Whether to watch every file in a team, every file in a project, or one file. Team webhooks need a team admin; project and file webhooks need edit access.
For Team or Project, the number after /team/ or /project/ in the Figma URL (e.g. figma.com/files/team/1234567890). For File, the file URL or file key.
triggers.library_published.props.info.de: Team ID: open the team in Figma; the URL is figma.com/files/team/**1234567890**/... Project ID: open the project; the URL is figma.com/files/project/**12345678**/... File: paste the file URL.
triggers.new_comment.description: Triggers when someone comments on a file in a team, project or single file. Needs a Figma Professional plan or higher (Starter teams are refused); team webhooks need a team admin, project and file webhooks need edit access.
triggers.new_comment.props.context.descr: Whether to watch every file in a team, every file in a project, or one file. Team webhooks need a team admin; project and file webhooks need edit access.
triggers.new_comment.props.info.descript: Team ID: open the team in Figma; the URL is figma.com/files/team/**1234567890**/... Project ID: open the project; the URL is figma.com/files/project/**12345678**/... File: paste the file URL.
triggers.new_comment.props.team_id.descr: For Team or Project, the number after /team/ or /project/ in the Figma URL (e.g. figma.com/files/team/1234567890). For File, the file URL or file key.
triggers.new_file_version.description: Triggers when a named version is saved in a file's version history. Needs a Figma Professional plan or higher (Starter teams are refused); team webhooks need a team admin, project and file webhooks need edit access.
Whether to watch every file in a team, every file in a project, or one file. Team webhooks need a team admin; project and file webhooks need edit access.
triggers.new_file_version.props.context_: For Team or Project, the number after /team/ or /project/ in the Figma URL (e.g. figma.com/files/team/1234567890). For File, the file URL or file key.
triggers.new_file_version.props.info.des: Team ID: open the team in Figma; the URL is figma.com/files/team/**1234567890**/... Project ID: open the project; the URL is figma.com/files/project/**12345678**/... File: paste the file URL.
